title: Three-PR programme closeout
body:
Three-PR closeout is complete. PRs #39, #36, and #40 are merged with all
actionable comments resolved and post-merge workflows green. The public plan
handoff keeps Track B primary and routes the parallel workspace lane to a dated
Visual PASS/FAIL gate before any manifest or move. The closeout seat has no
remaining claim, watcher, queue entry, or implementation task. Peer-owned
uncommitted editorial-routing edits in the main checkout remain excluded and
preserved under their existing custody.
